newsitem.title: TURKEY: Bomb blast at Turkish Islamist party building.
newsitem.headline: Bomb blast at Turkish Islamist party building.

text.p: A small bomb exploded at a branch office of Turkey's Islam-based Welfare Party on Monday but there were no casualties, Anatolian news agency said.
It said the windows of the party's office in Istanbul's Zeytinburnu district were broken by the blast.
Welfare is led by Necmettin Erbakan, who resigned last month under pressure from the secularist military after a stormy year as Turkey's first Islamist prime minister.
